body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk tool page block
Page: Rabbit Housing Size Calculator
How to use in WordPress:
1) Create/edit the page for the calculator.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Paste everything below into the block.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and article pages.
- Calculator runs fully in the browser; no plugin required.
-->

<section class="rccage-page alignfull" id="rabbit-housing-size-calculator">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-good: #4e6b45;
      --rc-good-soft: #eff8ed;
      --rc-warn: #9a6a1c;
      --rc-warn-soft: #fff5df;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rccage-page,
    .rccage-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rccage-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rccage-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    .rccage-page a:focus-visible,
    .rccage-page button:focus-visible,
    .rccage-page input:focus-visible,
    .rccage-page select:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rccage-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rccage-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rccage-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rccage-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rccage-btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 30px; }

    .rccage-btn,
    .rccage-calc-button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .rccage-btn:hover,
    .rccage-calc-button:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rccage-btn-primary,
    .rccage-calc-button {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rccage-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccage-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rccage-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rccage-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rccage-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.70), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.30) 48%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.06)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccage-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rccageFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 800px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay .rccage-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 620px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rccage-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rccage-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rccage-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rccage-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccage-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rccage-hero-card,
    .rccage-side-card,
    .rccage-panel,
    .rccage-size-card,
    .rccage-benefit,
    .rccage-item-card,
    .rccage-calculator,
    .rccage-result-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccage-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rccage-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rccage-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rccage-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rccage-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rccage-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rccage-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rccage-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccage-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rccage-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rccage-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rccage-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rccage-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rccage-section-header { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rccage-section h2,
    .rccage-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccage-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rccage-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rccage-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rccage-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rccage-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccage-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rccage-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rccage-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rccage-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rccage-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rccage-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rccage-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rccage-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rccage-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rccage-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rccage-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rccage-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rccage-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rccage-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rccage-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rccage-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    /* Calculator */
    .rccage-calc-section {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rccage-calculator {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: stretch;
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rccage-calc-form {
      display: grid;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 28px);
      border-radius: 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rccage-calc-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .rccage-field {
      display: grid;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .rccage-field label {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rccage-field small {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rccage-field input,
    .rccage-field select {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      background: #ffffff;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rccage-field input::placeholder { color: rgba(111, 106, 97, 0.72); }

    .rccage-radio-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .rccage-radio {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 58px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.14);
      background: #ffffff;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .rccage-radio input {
      position: absolute;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccage-radio:has(input:checked) {
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      border-color: rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.42);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    }

    .rccage-result-card {
      display: grid;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px);
      border-radius: 34px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.22), transparent 18rem),
        #ffffff;
    }

    .rccage-result-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .rccage-result-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
    }

    .rccage-result-badge.good { background: var(--rc-good-soft); color: var(--rc-good); }
    .rccage-result-badge.warn { background: var(--rc-warn-soft); color: var(--rc-warn); }
    .rccage-result-badge.bad { background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rccage-result-card h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.15rem);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.035em;
    }

    .rccage-result-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rccage-result-numbers {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .rccage-result-number {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rccage-result-number strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .rccage-result-number span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rccage-progress {
      width: 100%;
      height: 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #f2eadf;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rccage-progress-bar {
      width: 0%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      transition: width 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rccage-result-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rccage-result-list li {
      padding: 13px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.92);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 780;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.08);
    }

    .rccage-result-list li strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rccage-size-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rccage-size-card {
      padding: 26px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rccage-size-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }

    .rccage-size-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      margin: 0 auto 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.7rem;
    }

    .rccage-size-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .rccage-size-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 750; }

    .rccage-table-wrap {
      margin-top: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      border-radius: 26px;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccage-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      background: #ffffff;
      min-width: 600px;
    }

    .rccage-table th,
    .rccage-table td {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      text-align: left;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
    }

    .rccage-table th { background: #fff9ef; color: var(--rc-moss); font-weight: 950; }
    .rccage-table td { color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 750; }
    .rccage-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

    .rccage-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rccage-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById("rccageCalcForm");
      if (!form) return;

      const statusBadge = document.getElementById("rcStatusBadge");
      const areaPercent = document.getElementById("rcAreaPercent");
      const resultTitle = document.getElementById("rcResultTitle");
      const resultText = document.getElementById("rcResultText");
      const areaM = document.getElementById("rcAreaM");
      const targetM = document.getElementById("rcTargetM");
      const progressBar = document.getElementById("rcProgressBar");
      const adviceList = document.getElementById("rcAdviceList");

      function getChecked(name) {
        const checked = form.querySelector('input[name="' + name + '"]:checked');
        return checked ? checked.value : "";
      }

      function toMetres(value, unit) {
        const number = Number(value);
        if (!isFinite(number) || number <= 0) return 0;

        if (unit === "cm") return number / 100;
        if (unit === "ft") return number * 0.3048;
        if (unit === "in") return number * 0.0254;
        return number;
      }

      function fmt(value, suffix) {
        if (!isFinite(value)) return "—";
        return value.toLocaleString("en-GB", {
          maximumFractionDigits: value >= 10 ? 1 : 2,
          minimumFractionDigits: value < 10 ? 1 : 0
        }) + suffix;
      }

      function calculateTarget(rabbits, rabbitSize) {
        let target = 6;

        if (rabbits > 2) {
          target += (rabbits - 2) * 1.5;
        }

        if (rabbitSize === "large") {
          target *= 1.15;
        }

        if (rabbitSize === "giant") {
          target *= 1.35;
        }

        return target;
      }

      function updateResult(event) {
        if (event) event.preventDefault();

        const rabbits = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, parseInt(document.getElementById("rcRabbits").value, 10) || 1));
        const unit = document.getElementById("rcUnit").value;
        const lengthM = toMetres(document.getElementById("rcLength").value, unit);
        const widthM = toMetres(document.getElementById("rcWidth").value, unit);
        const heightM = toMetres(document.getElementById("rcHeight").value, unit);
        const rabbitSize = document.getElementById("rcRabbitSize").value;
        const setup = getChecked("setup");
        const access = getChecked("access");

        const area = lengthM * widthM;
        const target = calculateTarget(rabbits, rabbitSize);
        const percent = target > 0 ? Math.round((area / target) * 100) : 0;
        const safePercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));

        areaM.textContent = fmt(area, " m²");
        targetM.textContent = fmt(target, " m²");
        areaPercent.textContent = percent + "% of target";
        progressBar.style.width = safePercent + "%";

        let status = "bad";
        let title = "This setup looks too small.";
        let text = "Try to increase the usable floor space before relying on accessories or short play sessions.";
        let advice = [];

        if (!area || !heightM) {
          status = "warn";
          title = "Add your measurements to check the setup.";
          text = "Enter the usable length, width and height of the space your rabbits can access.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Measure inside:</strong> Use the usable internal space, not the outer footprint.",
            "<strong>Linked areas:</strong> Only count areas your rabbits can freely access."
          ];
        } else if (area >= target && heightM >= 1 && access === "always") {
          status = "good";
          title = "This setup looks generous against the calculator target.";
          text = "Your measurements meet or exceed the suggested floor space and height target. Keep focusing on safety, flooring, enrichment and daily checks.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Great space:</strong> Add hiding places, tunnels, hay areas and enrichment without crowding the floor.",
            "<strong>Keep checking:</strong> Watch behaviour, appetite, droppings and signs of boredom.",
            "<strong>Safety:</strong> Make sure flooring is non-slip and the setup is secure."
          ];
        } else if (area >= target && heightM >= 1) {
          status = "warn";
          title = "The size looks good, but access may be the issue.";
          text = "Your space meets the suggested size target, but rabbits benefit most when the full area is available all the time.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Access:</strong> Try to make the run or pen permanently available if safe to do so.",
            "<strong>Routine:</strong> Short exercise sessions are helpful, but they should not replace a roomy home base.",
            "<strong>Safety:</strong> Check doors, panels, flooring and predator protection."
          ];
        } else if (area >= target * 0.75) {
          status = "warn";
          title = "This setup is close, but could be improved.";
          text = "Your enclosure is near the suggested target, but extra space would give your rabbits more room for movement and enrichment.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Add space:</strong> Consider adding a permanent run, larger pen or rabbit-proofed room access.",
            "<strong>Reduce clutter:</strong> Keep accessories useful but avoid filling too much floor space.",
            "<strong>Height check:</strong> Make sure rabbits can stand upright without touching the roof."
          ];
        } else {
          status = "bad";
          title = "This setup is likely too small.";
          text = "The usable floor space is below the calculator target. Rabbits need room to hop, stretch, run, hide and explore every day.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Upgrade first:</strong> Increase the main living space before adding more toys or accessories.",
            "<strong>Permanent run:</strong> A secure attached run or larger pen can make a big difference.",
            "<strong>Avoid hutch-only living:</strong> A hutch alone is not enough as a rabbit's main home."
          ];
        }

        if (heightM > 0 && heightM < 1) {
          status = status === "good" ? "warn" : status;
          advice.push("<strong>Height:</strong> Aim for at least 1m so rabbits can stand upright and move comfortably.");
        }

        if (setup === "outdoor") {
          advice.push("<strong>Outdoor safety:</strong> Check predator protection, shade, weatherproofing, locks and flooring.");
        }

        if (setup === "free-roam") {
          advice.push("<strong>Free roam:</strong> Rabbit-proof wires, unsafe plants, furniture gaps and slippery floors.");
        }

        if (rabbits >= 3) {
          advice.push("<strong>Group housing:</strong> Larger groups need extra space so rabbits can move away from each other.");
        }

        statusBadge.className = "rccage-result-badge " + status;
        statusBadge.textContent = status === "good" ? "Looks good" : status === "warn" ? "Could improve" : "Needs more space";
        resultTitle.textContent = title;
        resultText.textContent = text;

        adviceList.innerHTML = advice.map(function (item) {
          return "<li>" + item + "</li>";
        }).join("");
      }

      form.addEventListener("submit", updateResult);
      form.addEventListener("input", updateResult);
      form.addEventListener("change", updateResult);
      updateResult();
    })();
  </script>
